name: Kachari Ruins (Ruins of Kachari Rajbari)
description: Medieval ruins of the Dimasa Kachari kingdom capital featuring unique mushroom-domed sandstone pillars and carved monoliths dating to the 10th-13th centuries.
facts: Ancient capital of the Dimasa Kachari kingdom before Ahom invasion
Features mushroom-shaped and V-shaped carved sandstone pillars with animal and geometric motifs
Managed by Archaeological Survey of India (ASI Monument ID N-NL-1)
Located in the heart of Dimapur near Naga Shopping Arcade and Circuit House

name: Dimapur Town
description: Largest city and commercial gateway of Nagaland, situated on the Dhansiri River plains, serving as the primary entry point with airport and railway station.
facts: Main commercial and transport hub of Nagaland
Ancient capital of the Kachari kingdom known historically as the Brick City
Only major plains area in hilly Nagaland with the state's sole airport and key railway station
Elevation approximately 145-150 meters above sea level

name: NEZCC Stone Garden and North East Heritage Museum
description: North East Zone Cultural Centre complex featuring a stone sculpture garden with works by Indian artists and a museum showcasing crafts and artifacts from the eight northeastern states.
facts: Stone sculpture garden displays 31 sculptures by renowned Indian artists
Includes traditional morungs, amphitheater, and children's park
Museum preserves cultural heritage of Northeast India through crafts and artifacts
Located about 3 km from Dimapur railway station and near the airport

name: Green Park
description: Landscaped recreational park within the State Horticulture Nursery at 4th Mile, offering boating, adventure activities, and picnic spots amid greenery.
facts: Located inside State Horticulture Nursery at 4th Mile, Dimapur
Features boating, water zorbing, ziplining, kids train, and restaurant
Popular for picnics and family outings with nominal entry fee
Best visited October to March during peak tourism season

name: Nagaland Science Centre
description: Interactive science museum behind Naga Shopping Arcade promoting scientific temperament with galleries on senses, children's exhibits, and fun science.
facts: Established under Department of Science and Technology, Government of Nagaland
Features galleries including Our Senses, Children’s Corner, and Fun Science
Includes science park and planetarium elements; closed on Mondays
Located near Kachari Ruins at Super Market Lane, Half Nagarjan

name: Hong Kong Market
description: Bustling flea market in central Dimapur known for affordable imported clothing, footwear, electronics, and local goods, a popular shopping destination for visitors.
facts: Famous for bargain shopping of clothes, jewellery, electronics from Myanmar, Thailand, and China
Grew from Tibetan trader stalls in the early 1980s into a major commercial hub
Located in the heart of Dimapur, easily accessible from railway station
Open typically 10 AM to 7 PM; bargaining is common

name: Dimapur Airport
description: The sole civil airport in Nagaland, serving as the primary aerial gateway for tourists and residents connecting to major Indian cities.
facts: Only commercial airport in Nagaland, located about 7-8 km from city centre
Handles domestic flights connecting Dimapur to cities like Guwahati, Kolkata, and Delhi
Tourist information and ILP facilitation available at arrival terminal
Key entry point for accessing the rest of the state by road

name: Dhansiri River (Dimapur section)
description: Major river flowing along the eastern side of Dimapur, a tributary of the Brahmaputra, offering riverside views, birdwatching, and recreational spots.
facts: Flows east of Dimapur city as a tributary of the Brahmaputra
Provides scenic riverside walks and winter birdwatching opportunities
Historically significant to the Kachari settlement and modern urban development
Accessible from multiple points in the city for local recreation
